livre.title: Transformation Digitale de l'Administration
livre.subtitle: Le premier livre traitant de la transformation digitale de l'administration en Algérie
livre.preface: Préface Par Pr. Youcef Mentalecheta, "le père de l'informatique en Algérie"
livre.quote: "Allah ne change rien en un peuple tant qu'ils ne changent pas ce qui est en eux-mêmes"
livre.paragraph_1: Ce livre aborde de manière accessible les concepts, avantages et défis de l'e-gouvernement dans le contexte algérien. Il s'adresse aux décideurs, journalistes, professionnels du secteur public et privé, chercheurs et étudiants.
livre.paragraph_2: L'objectif est de fournir une compréhension claire de la transformation digitale de l'administration publique et de ses implications pour le développement du pays.
livre.author_bio: Ancien président du Groupement des Acteurs du Numérique Algérien (GAAN) de 2020 à 2022, expert reconnu en transformation digitale.
livre.preview_footer: Accédez à l'aperçu complet du livre via Google Drive

about.title: About
about.subtitle: Our commitment to excellence and compliance
about.p1: Tadjeddine & Partners is a leading consulting firm in Algeria, specializing in strategic consulting and compliance support, particularly in personal data protection (Law 18-07). We provide customized solutions to companies, public institutions, and non-profit organizations, helping them overcome complex challenges, comply with regulatory requirements, and improve their performance.
about.p2: Our expertise is based on a team of experienced consultants and the regular production of in-depth sectoral studies, which inform our clients' strategic decisions. Guided by values of integrity, ethics, and excellence, we are committed to generating a lasting impact in a constantly evolving environment.

sections.title: 1. Identity of the Data Controller
sections.content:
In accordance with the provisions of Law No. 18-07 of June 10, 2018, relating to the protection of personal data, the data controller for the collected data is TADJEDDINE AND PARTNERS, a company registered in the Commercial Register under the number 10B0981001, whose head office is located at Cité Naimi, Rue G N° 1, Zabana, Blida, represented by its legal manager Mr. Tadjeddine BACHIR.

In its capacity as data controller, TADJEDDINE AND PARTNERS is committed to complying with all applicable legal and regulatory obligations regarding the protection of personal data.

sections.title: 2. Collected Data
sections.content:
As part of its commercial activities, TADJEDDINE AND PARTNERS collects and processes the following data concerning its prospects:

  • First and last name
  • Email address

sections.title: 3. Purposes of Processing
sections.content:
The collected data is processed exclusively for the following purposes:

  • Responding to contact or information requests made by prospects
  • Sending commercial offers tailored to expressed needs
  • Following up on pre-contractual commercial relationships
  • Conducting internal commercial analysis and statistics

sections.title: 4. Data Recipients
sections.content:
Personal data is processed exclusively by authorized personnel of TADJEDDINE AND PARTNERS and is neither transferred nor sold to third parties.

Any potential transmission to technical subcontractors (notably email service providers) is governed by a contract including strict obligations of confidentiality and compliance with the provisions of Law No. 18-07.

sections.title: 5. Retention Period
sections.content: Collected data is kept for a maximum period of three (3) years from the last contact or interaction from the prospect, unless opposition or withdrawal of consent is exercised in accordance with legal provisions.

sections.title: 6. Security Measures
sections.content: TADJEDDINE AND PARTNERS implements all appropriate technical and organizational measures to ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of processed personal data.

sections.title: 7. Rights of Data Subjects
sections.content:
In accordance with articles 7 and 34 to 36 of Law No. 18-07, any data subject has the following rights:

  • Right of access to their personal data
  • Right of rectification of inaccurate or incomplete data
  • Right to object to processing for legitimate reasons
  • Right to withdraw consent at any time

To exercise these rights, any request can be addressed:

By email to the following address: info@tadjeddine-partners.com

By postal mail to the head office address: TADJEDDINE AND PARTNERS, Cité Naimi, Rue G N° 1, Zabana, Blida.

sections.title: 8. International Data Transfers
sections.content: No transfer of personal data abroad is made without obtaining the prior authorizations required by Law No. 18-07.

sections.title: 9. Policy Updates
